title: Pat Price remote views underground base in Mount Hayes and three other mountains
place_text: Mount Hayes, Alaska; Mount Perdido, Spain; Mount Inyangani, Zimbabwe; Mount Ziel, Australia

tellings.quote: During the CIA's remote viewing program in 1973, psychic spy Pat Price described a massive underground [music] base inside Mount Hayes, Alaska. It had advanced technology, consoles, personnel that looked like military. He named three more bases, Mount Perdido in Spain, Mount Inyangani in Zimbabwe, Mount Ziel in Australia.
Pat Price saw the four alien bases and um they did project 8200 before I got there.
tellings.difference: Calls the bases alien, names the work Project 8200, and places it before Buchanan joined the unit, with no date given.
tellings.link_reason: Pat Price remote viewing the four mountain bases is the same 1973 episode as the story of Price naming Mount Hayes and three other bases.

as_told.title: Project 8200: Pat Price views four alien bases

tellings.quote: Pat Price's remote viewing these alien bases across the earth under skip atwater
tellings.difference: Places the work under Skip Atwater rather than the CIA and names no specific mountains.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Pat Price remote viewing alien bases across the Earth in the 1970s.

as_told.title: Pat Price remote views alien bases under Skip Atwater

tellings.quote: program like you know Skip Atwater had this program and I think Pat Price was tasked with remote viewing uh I think these these bases these alien bases all over the world.
tellings.difference: Credits the program to Skip Atwater, names Spain without Mount Perdido, leaves out Zimbabwe and is told with less certainty.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Pat Price, during the 1970s CIA remote viewing work, viewing alien bases inside mountains including Mount Hayes, Mount Zeil and a site in Spain.

as_told.title: Pat Price remote-views alien bases worldwide
as_told.place_text: Mount Zeil, Australia; Mount Hayes, Alaska; Spain

plain: In 1973 a psychic named Pat Price, working in a government program of remote viewing, the attempt to see distant places with the mind, is said to have described a huge underground base inside Mount Hayes in Alaska, with "consoles" and staff who "looked like military". Michels tells it himself as part of the CIA's program, adding three more bases Price named: Mount Perdido in Spain, Mount Inyangani in Zimbabwe and Mount Ziel in Australia; in other episodes he places the work under a man named Skip Atwater and is less sure of the details. An Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan, who later worked as a remote viewer, tells Michels that "Pat Price saw the four alien bases" in a project called Project 8200, before Buchanan joined the unit. If true, someone would be running hidden bases inside mountains around the world.
